live.title: Your scale
live.unsettled: Wait for the number to settle…

status.waiting: Waiting for you to step on the scale
status.connected: Connected, wait for the number to settle…
status.off: Not listening. Turn on Capture automatically or tap Try a weigh-in.

live.needsKey: Enter the scale key below first, then this scale can be read.

problem.permission: JoyoFit is not allowed to use Bluetooth yet. Open settings to allow it.
problem.off: Bluetooth is off. Turn it on, then try again.
problem.unavailable: Bluetooth can't be used right now.

card.empty: No scale yet. Find yours below.
card.weightOnlyNote: Weight only: this scale sends no body fat or impedance, so JoyoFit shows none.

picker.title: Find your scale
picker.explain: JoyoFit will scan for Bluetooth devices around you to find your scale. The scan results are only used on this phone.
picker.hint: Step on the scale until its display lights up, then search. Many scales are only visible while they are awake.
picker.none: Nothing in sight yet. Make sure the scale's display is on and your phone's Bluetooth is on.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoHint: While the app is open and you step on the scale, your weight is saved right away.
settings.rogoHint: Your weight goes into JoyoRogo's weight log: one number per day, the latest one counts.
settings.guardHint: If the weight is far from your last weigh-in, for example someone else stepped on, you are asked first.

confirm.title: Is this you?
confirm.message: The scale read {{weight}} kg, but your last weight was {{last}} kg. Save it as your weight?

history.title: Weigh-in history
history.pending: Waiting to be sent to JoyoRogo
history.waiting: {{count}} weigh-ins not sent to JoyoRogo yet

body.estimateNote: An estimate from a general formula using the impedance and the height, age and sex in your profile. It can differ from the number in the scale's own app.
body.needProfile: Fill in height, birth year and sex in Profile so body composition can be estimated.

record.title: Record scale data
record.body: Scale not recognised? Pick its device in the search list, start recording, then step on the scale. JoyoFit writes everything the scale sends to the app log. Copy or share the result so support for it can be added.
record.connectHint: Also records the data sent over a connection. Nothing is sent to the scale.
record.none: Search first, then pick the devices to record.

supported.title: Supported scales
supported.body: JoyoFit reads scales with the protocols below. Others can be added through Record scale data.

secret.title: Scale key (advanced)
secret.rejected: The scale refused the saved key. Remove the key, then enter it again.
secret.addressExplain: The iPhone does not tell the scale's Bluetooth address, so enter it too (for example AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

tuya-local-key.summary: This scale encrypts its weight, so it needs its local key (16 characters) before it can be read.
tuya-local-key.explain: Tuya scales encrypt their weight, so JoyoFit needs your scale's local key. It comes from the Tuya developer platform (iot.tuya.com): create a cloud project, link the app account the scale is paired in, then copy that device's local_key. This is a technical step. The key is stored encrypted on this phone and is not sent anywhere.
tuya-local-key.invalid: The local key must be exactly 16 characters (letters, digits or plain symbols).

huawei-hagrid.summary: This scale needs 3 keys (CAK, C1, C2) before it will send data.
huawei-hagrid.explain: The keys are stored encrypted on this phone and are not sent anywhere.
huawei-hagrid.invalid: CAK, C1 and C2 must each be exactly 32 hex digits (0-9, a-f), and the Bluetooth address 12 hex digits.
